body: … the notifications you get when you’ve not used the app for a while (e.g. semester break) seriously sound like an abusive partner! Passive aggressive and nagging. author: Couic's

title: Nice app but vibration is too short
body:
The app is really nice but I would line to point out 2 features that would be really nice: -being able to choose a custom vibration pattern. currently, the vibration when the phone is silenced is too short for me. I often do not notice the break alerts and I can‘t change the vibration pattern to be longer (I can change the sound but not how long the vibration is) -it would be really nice to have timers without the pomodoro features. that way, you could have multiple timers tracking for example the intake of prescription drugs or time spent in the gym or running, without scheduling breaks or having to know how long it will take.

Also I think it is absolutely crucial to have a widget for the to-do list and then a separate one for the currently selected pomodoro. Otherwise using this app as your personal to do app becomes much too annoying !
